literal_meaning: নাম উল্লেখ করা বা নাম স্মরণ করা
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুর নাম করে বলল যে সে আসবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I was just mentioning your name today.
She mentioned her friend's name saying he would come.
note: This is a basic idiomatic expression in Bengali for referring to someone by name in conversation.
